description: octo-T8 and its three levers (the octo draft, the bundled attention, the glue levers at eight-row users) on the fused stack: the integrator's own manifest. The gate-only twins (-octo3, -octo3-quaddraft, -octo3-audit on the combined arm and on the combined prefill arm) are generated by make_octo3_profiles.py, not here; this file places the image file, the tests and the two SHIP CANDIDATES (traffic profiles under one owner traffic waiver, decision PENDING).

image_files.reason: packed_verifier imports it at module level (QWEN_FAST_AUDIT_FIRST / QWEN_FAST_AUDIT_EVERY: the sampled host read-back audits); inert while both are unset

ship.name: traffic-o3
ship.reason: the third ship candidate (2026-10-11): the approved fusion ship profile -fx-traffic plus octo-T8 and its three levers, every eligible 8-live round on the octo block (QWEN_FAST_OCTO=live, no alternation), plus QWEN_FAST_TAP_WINDOW_ALIGNED=1 (the tile-aligned drafter window of the parked-engine rebind), and the third block's memory plan (the KV pool 19,968 to 16,500 blocks, the trace region 512 to 640 MiB). It differs from -fx-traffic by exactly those env keys and the pool; the exactness control is -fx-traffic on the same image

waiver.waives: the pinned qualification records of the octo shape and its three levers, which no card has qualified: (1) QWEN_FAST_OCTO=live, the third packed block of eight users of eight rows (one 64-row verify pass instead of two M3 passes at eight live seats): its attention is the K64j extent program at flags 0x21 with one eight-row group per bundle (geometry G8B1), which is outside the pinned four-card evidence records (packed_any_evidence_tp4.json and packed_any_evidence_tp4_262144.json cover the served G8B2 programs at flags 0x23 and the multi-user launch is the M3 blocks' own), the batched GDN launch at eight users (96 cores, one wave) has no card-M record, and the serving_octo admission refuses the shape outside a gate run of a gate-only profile (QWEN_C2_GATE=1 with QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE=1) - this waiver is the one other way in, named by the profile's own QWEN_FAST_OCTO_WAIVER; (2) QWEN_FAST_OCTO_ATTN_BUNDLE=4, the octo block's attention in two K64j launches of four users per layer (flags 0x21 with B > 1 entries, 16 cores per entry, no kernel or factory change), outside every record; (3) QWEN_FAST_OCTO_GLUE8=1, the GDN split, merge, block conv and packed windows run by quarter-tile data-movement kernels at eight-row users (exact by construction and by the in-trace audit of the audited attach, with no card-M mover harness and no pinned record); (4) QWEN_FAST_OCTO_DRAFT=1, one eight-seat, eight-row draft pass in place of the two quads for an all-eight-live octo round (it can change only how many tokens a round commits, never which, and its trace beside engine reuse is not in the draft book: the coordinator rebuilds it after a rebound member); and QWEN_FAST_OCTO_MIN_LIVE=6, the eligibility knob. A record could replace this waiver: the K64j card jobs Q1w, Q1a and Q1b (k64j_card_b.py --kv-heads 1 --octo: G8B1 at flags 0x21 equal to its compile-time twin at every family and start, one trace over more than 50 families, the stale-writer zone and the native one-row decode against the one-entry call) with a bundle arm for B = 4 (not built), Q2 (gdn_tp4_card_test.py --users 8 --rows 8: one launch equal to eight per-user launches bit for bit) and a quarter-tile mover harness (not built), recorded in a new pinned section of the packed-any evidence beside the G8B2 one (not built); until then the owner's decision stands in for them. The op-fusion levers and QWEN_FAST_TAP_WINDOW_ALIGNED this profile also sets are the fusion ship waiver's kind (default-off, exact by construction and by audit, no contract mechanism) and are inherited from w2-er-fx-262k-2026-10-11 and named here as the owner's decision, not as a mechanism
evidence: tp4/octo-2 on the Lever N stack (image tp4-octo2-1, 8 live, ~3.5k-token coding prompts, QWEN_FAST_OCTO=alternate so half the rounds are octo and half the two-quad m3 shape, paired per round against the arm's own m3 rounds with scripts/ci/octo2_report.py): the octo draft +6.1% committed tokens per second per seat on octo rounds (early draft -12 ms, tokens per seat-round -2%), the glue levers +28.6%, the attention bundle +2.5% (the 32k read of that run had no octo round in it: no 8-live decode window), all three together +46.6% (35.46 against 24.20); runs 38096633389 (control), 38097257289 (draft), 38100444114 (glue8), 38101222763 (bundle), 38101791976 (all three), 38102380592 (control repeat)
text: scripts/ci/octo_compare.py, 24 of 24 answers identical to the control in every arm of that run set (concurrent8_steady, concurrent8_code_equal and concurrent8_code_32k)

the octo shape alone, first card run on the Lever N stack (O3): +3.5% committed tokens per second per seat against the m3 rounds of the same boot; the octo block's verify trace 86.5 ms against 2 x 50-54 ms

what has NOT run: any octo lever on this stack (W2, engine reuse, the op-fusion levers, 13x10 grid) or as a traffic profile; the audited glue8 attach of tp4/octo-2 did not complete (warm-up 412 s, 3.4 tok/s a seat: every round audited two layers of 73 entries; fixed in tp4/octo-3 by audit sampling); the audited attach A1, the paired decode ABAB and the ship gates G1, GX0, GX1, G2 and SR of references/fusion-jobs/ship-traffic-octo3 have not run on this profile

the fusion ship waiver w2-er-fx-262k-2026-10-11 and its evidence (docs/tp4-fusion.md), approved 2026-10-11, which this profile carries unchanged; docs/tp4-octo3.md has the lever-by-lever status on the fused stack
waiver.decision: PENDING: requested on 2026-10-11 for the owner's decision; no octo lever has run on the fused stack or as a traffic profile, and the audited attach A1, the paired decode ABAB and the ship gates have not run on this profile

ship.read_note: OCTO READ (tp4/octo-3, the shape and its three levers run under this profile's waiver): python3 scripts/ci/octo_judge.py --container-log <container log> --profile <ship profile> clean, i.e. exactly one '[OCTO] admitted mode=live ... (owner traffic waiver <id>)' line; the six '[OCTO] UNQUALIFIED' lines, which are EXPECTED here (they are the card questions the waiver stands in for: the 'no UNQUALIFIED admission line' of an SR read applies to the 262k evidence waiver, not to them); at least 16 rounds with shape=octo at 8 live and rows=8 and no program compiled on the first octo round; the octo draft engaged once and serving at least half of the octo rounds at 8 live with no fallback or disabled line; the bundled attention engaged once with its call line; the glue8 engaged lines at users=8 rows=8 for every site and no fell-back line; the K/V page writer's 'octo 8-row served path' line once; the TAP window lever's engaged line and no fell-back line. concurrent8_steady is the test that supplies the octo rounds (the skew, stall and drain shapes run below six live seats most of the time).
